frase_inicial: Daniel and Emily: let’s go step by step and check one simple protection gap first

tarjetas.frente: Life cover for Daniel and Emily
tarjetas.reverso: If one of you dies, mortgage, school and daily costs fall on the other and the kids. Start by checking what each policy actually pays and who is listed as beneficiary.
tarjetas.detalle: Current whole-life: Daniel $250,000; Emily $200,000. Recommended ranges noted in plan. Confirm policy death benefit and beneficiary names.

tarjetas.reverso: A large claim could reach your savings and paychecks. Find out today whether your home and car policies are active so we know what an extra layer would sit on top of.
tarjetas.detalle: Plan recommends $1,000,000 umbrella. Data shows home and vehicle insurance fields not recorded; confirm with insurers.

tarjetas.reverso: Right now you would lean on the credit card if paychecks stopped. Decide together whether to hold the next few months' cash in the joint savings account.
tarjetas.detalle: Accessible cash today: $19,000 across checking, savings and money market. Target in plan is 8–9 months of essentials.

tarjetas.frente: The high-rate credit card costs a lot
tarjetas.reverso: Carrying that balance means interest eats your yearly spare cash. One option is to pay a bit more each month so less interest builds up later.
tarjetas.detalle: Credit card balance $18,000 at 24.9%; current monthly payment $450, plan projects payoff around January 2034 at current payment.

tarjetas.frente: Retirement needs a plan, not a rush
tarjetas.reverso: Retirement is the biggest long-term need, but it draws on the same yearly spare cash as protection and college. We’ll plan trade-offs together so neither of you is surprised.
tarjetas.detalle: Plan shows no current contributions to employer retirement accounts; required extra annual saving noted in plan for gap analysis.

siguiente_paso.razon: Protection is the weakest area and matters most for the kids and mortgage. Confirming what your life policies pay and who benefits is quick and tells us whether to add cover next.
pasos: Both look for the life policy documents or the insurer emails together
Read aloud the death benefit and beneficiary name on each policy
Take a photo of each policy page and save it to a shared folder or your phone
